frequency_question: How often does the Ministry of Finance follow through on implementing announced fiscal/payment gateway mandates within the stated timeframe when they possess direct statutory authority?
membership_rule: Includes all direct executive notifications or regulatory rollouts in the fintech/taxation domain issued by the Union Finance Ministry since 2016. Excludes legislation requiring parliamentary passage or judicial initiatives.

cases.name: TCS (Tax Collected at Source) on foreign remittances rollout (2023)

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 5 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 5 major direct executive mandates sampled; all successfully implemented on schedule without legislative interference.
known_gaps: Does not capture informal back-channel rollbacks that occurred prior to official notification publishing.
skeleton: Direct executive policy announcements in the Indian financial sector executed via notification
multiplier: 5 hits out of 5 instances where the Ministry possessed absolute authority and stated intent
validity_reason: The administrative framework and bureaucratic mechanisms within the Ministry of Finance for direct notifications remain stable over multi-year political cycles.
